badges.label: Installs and runs npm or PyPI packages without a fixed version
badges.detail: tsx: installs the newest version each time

badges.label: Its AI agent can run commands on your computer without asking you
badges.detail: Commands run as you, so they can read and change any of your files and start other programs.

badges.label: Signs in using another app's identity
badges.detail: Signs in as Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot for VS Code

badges.label: Changes settings in other programs or on your computer
badges.detail: Changes the settings of Claude Code

badges.label: Keeps its own tables in Zotero's database
badges.detail: Tables: contextual, llm_for_zotero_claude_conversations, llm_for_zotero_conversation_fork_links, llm_for_zotero_conversation_registry, llm_for_zotero_global_conversations and 1 more

badges.label: Downloads and runs Python and PDF tools the first time you ask about a figure; someone other than its developer can change what runs at any time
badges.detail: The file belongs to yilewang, the developer of the original llm-for-zotero, not this plugin's developer: they can replace it at any time, and nothing checks it before it runs, and what they put there runs on your computer. The first time you ask about a figure, it downloads a 265–491 MB bundle of Python and the Poppler PDF tools from the original llm-for-zotero's GitHub release and runs it, without asking; the README doesn't mention it. What's there now is standard software: we checked the macOS (Apple silicon) bundle, and every file is from conda-forge. We reviewed version 3.9.9; this release has the same code.

badges.label: A zotero:// link (a web page can open one) can make it install add-ons without asking you
A zotero:// link can make it run code if you approve a prompt
Launches programs on your computer
badges.detail: Programs it names include curl, node; a setting lets Claude Code and Codex CLI run without asking

badges.label: Reuses a sign-in you saved in another program
badges.detail: Reuses the sign-in you saved in Codex CLI

Works with files on your computer

Other programs on this computer can change your library through it
Lets programs on this computer connect through Zotero's built-in server
